sql: SELECT r.pmid, r.pmcid, r.title, r.firstPublicationDate, regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*35\.1[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '28478132' AND r.abstractText LIKE '%35.1%' LIMIT 5
rows: Lipid-modifying efficacy and tolerability of anacetrapib added to ongoing statin therapy in Japanese patients with dyslipidemia.
